en_how: Four metro lines are polylines restricted to horizontal, vertical and 45° segments, with every corner rounded by the same quadratic curve and resampled by arc length; each frame a Canvas 2D paper texture draws each line's prefix for the current time, a glowing pen tip sits at the end, and stations (white dots) and interchanges (black-outlined white capsules) pop in as the pen passes, while the river is a flat blue band; the texture lies on a Three.js plane, a perspective camera skims low across the paper, and the top and bottom of the frame are blurred by distance to fake shallow depth of field.
